name: The Devil's Gospel
source:
A simple sin can grow into a deal your soul cannot fulfill...
Seven souls for your filthy one...

Would you make the trade if you had little choice?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/the-devils-gospel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个简单的罪行，可能逐渐变成你无法偿还的灵魂交易……

用七个灵魂交换你肮脏的灵魂……

如果选择很少，你会做这笔交易吗？

[来源：[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/the-devils-gospel]Itch.io[/url]]
